run_ml_inference_her: run the ml_inference script to perform HER voltage prediction on computational and experimental data
run_volcano_plot: run the ml_inference script to generate a volcano plot of PC1 vs predicted voltage
run_parity_plot: run the ml_inference script with cv_results_csv to generate a parity plot of experimental vs predicted voltage
get_computational_df_to_predict: get aggregate energies per bulk material from a CSV or parquet file for ML inference
review_get_computational_df_to_predict: review the get_computational_df_to_predict function that loads and aggregates computational energy data by bulk_id
